description: This file defines the EntityIdExistsOption class, which encapsulates options for validating whether an entity ID exists, with boolean properties to specify if the ID should be numeric and positive, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: EntityIdExistsOption
classes.description: A class representing validation options for entity IDs, including whether the ID should be numeric and positive.

methods.name: isNumeric
methods.description: Returns whether the ID should be numeric.

methods.name: setNumeric
methods.description: Sets whether the ID should be numeric.

methods.name: isPositive
methods.description: Returns whether the ID should be positive.

methods.name: setPositive
methods.description: Sets whether the ID should be positive.
